movie.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
movie.originalTitle: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
movie.overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: The tight-knit bond and global travel dreams of best friends Olli and Matze are thrown into chaos when Matze falls deeply in love with Rebecca.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Olli and Matze have always done everything together, sharing an apartment, working the same job, and saving up for a long-awaited trip around the world. However, their lifelong dynamic shifts abruptly when Matze meets Rebecca and enters a passionate romance. As Matze begins prioritizing his new relationship, Olli finds himself struggling with feelings of abandonment and jealousy. Olli must ultimately navigate the uncomfortable transition of his inner circle while learning to support his friend's newfound happiness.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Olli and Matze share an unbreakable brotherhood built on shared routines, mutual humor, and an ambitious plan to leave their daily lives behind to travel the world. Their partnership faces its biggest test when Matze meets Rebecca, a charming woman who instantly captures his heart. As Matze spends more of his time and energy courting Rebecca, the once-equal priority given to their friendship begins to crumble. Olli feels increasingly sidelined and views Rebecca as an unexpected intrusion into their carefully crafted future together. Tensions rise as the deadline for their grand trip approaches, forcing Olli to confront his deep-seated fears of being left behind and forgotten. Meanwhile, Matze finds himself pulled between his loyalty to his best friend and his growing affection for his new partner. Through a series of awkward encounters, emotional confrontations, and comedic miscommunications, all three must re-evaluate what intimacy and commitment mean. In the end, Olli learns to accept that relationships evolve, finding a way to preserve his friendship while granting Matze the room to pursue romance.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Olli and Matze are inseparable best friends whose lives are completely intertwined: they live under the same roof, work side-by-side, and share a long-standing dream of packing their bags to travel the globe together. Their comfortable, predictable routine is unexpectedly upended when Matze falls in love with Rebecca. As Matze's new romance quickly grows serious, Olli suddenly finds himself feeling like a third wheel in his own life, watching their shared goals fall by the wayside. Balancing lighthearted humor with grounded emotional reality, the story explores the bittersweet growing pains of adult friendship, shifting loyalties, and the struggle to adapt when a best friend finds love.

story_structure.climax: A central confrontation forces all three characters to face the reality of how their lives, feelings, and future plans have fundamentally changed.
story_structure.conflict: Matze begins a romantic relationship with Rebecca, introducing new dynamics that threaten to derail their shared travel plans and test the boundaries of their friendship.
story_structure.resolution: The group emerges with a clearer understanding of where they stand, recalibrating their relationships and individual paths moving forward.
story_structure.introduction: Olli and Matze share a close bond as best friends who live together, work side by side, and share ambitious plans to travel the world.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions build as Olli tries to navigate feeling sidelined, while Matze struggles to balance his growing feelings for Rebecca with his long-standing loyalty to Olli.
